lore_anchors.definition: A rare, sacred wood with innate lightning-attribute spiritual energy, used as the primary material for crafting high-grade flying swords.
Han Li's signature set of seventy-two flying swords, forged from Divine Thunder Bamboo and designed for mass sword formation combat.
A rare, carnivorous insect species that evolves through cannibalism, developing metallic golden carapaces as they advance; extremely difficult to cultivate in large numbers.
A spiritual herb used as feed to stimulate Gold Devourer Beetle reproduction and evolution.
A cultivator's internal fire essence, refined from their cultivation base and used for both combat and artifact crafting; overuse can temporarily damage one's foundation.
A precious, indestructible metal page containing high-level cultivation or artifact forging knowledge, often inherited from ancient or higher-realm sources.
A cultivator's most concentrated life essence; a small amount infused into a magic treasure creates a spiritual bond between the artifact and its owner.
The initial, unrefined shape of a flying sword before the final stages of forging, inscriptions, and spirit-binding are completed.
